title: Tudors & Elizabethan England
examples: What was the main difference in beliefs between Catholics and Protestants during that time?
How did the Spanish Armada affect England's power?
Can you explain what life was like for common people in Elizabethan England?

explain.say: Today we are learning about Tudors and Elizabethan England.
Religion was a big issue during this time period.
The threat from the Spanish Armada was a major event.
Society had a strict class system structure.
The Elizabethan era saw great cultural flourishing.
In real life, disagreements over rules cause conflict.

items: School rules must be followed by everyone.
Different sports have different rules to play.

faq.q: Why was religion such a big deal in England then?
faq.a: Religion was tied to who held political power. Disputes over faith often meant disputes over who ruled the country.
asks: Was religion more important than politics?
How did faith affect the government?

faq.q: What exactly was the Spanish Armada?
faq.a: It was a large fleet of Spanish warships sent to attack England. The English navy managed to defeat this powerful invasion force.
asks: Did England fight a big sea battle?
Who were the Spanish attacking England with?

faq.q: Who were the main social classes in Elizabethan England?
faq.a: The main classes were the nobility, who owned large estates, the gentry, and the working peasants.
asks: Did everyone have the same rights back then?
What was the difference between a lord and a peasant?

faq.q: Did the Tudors and Elizabeth I rule at the same time?
faq.a: No, the Tudors ruled before Elizabeth I. They were distinct periods of English monarchy.
asks: Did one follow the other immediately?

faq.q: What was the main difference between Catholic and Protestant views?
faq.a: Catholics believed in the Pope's authority, while Protestants emphasized reading the Bible directly.
asks: What did Protestants believe about the Pope?
Which group focused more on scripture?

facts: Elizabeth I reigned during a period of great national pride.
The conflict between Catholics and Protestants was a major source of tension.
The defeat of the Spanish Armada boosted English confidence greatly.
Society was highly structured, with status determined by birth and land.

quiz.say: The primary difference in belief between Catholics and Protestants concerned:
quiz.why: The core disagreement was over who held ultimate religious authority.

wrong.1: Clothing was a social marker, not the main religious difference.
wrong.2: Taxes were a government issue, not the central religious debate.
wrong.3: While language mattered, the source of doctrine was the key split.

quiz.say: The Spanish Armada was defeated by:

options.show: A sudden change in the weather
options.say: A sudden change in the weather

quiz.why: The English fleet successfully defended the nation against the invasion.

wrong.1: While they helped, the organized navy was the deciding factor.
wrong.2: Foreign aid was not the primary source of the victory.
wrong.3: The battle was fought by skilled military action, not just weather.

quiz.say: In the social pyramid, the group at the very top was:
quiz.why: The nobility held the highest status and most land ownership.

wrong.1: The gentry were below the nobility in established rank.
wrong.2: The peasants formed the largest group at the base.
wrong.3: While wealthy, they did not hold the highest hereditary status.
